title: I built a generative learning game for kids aged 6-12, launched the beta this week-end, kids are doing the most amazing things in there:
author: kouklimou
selftext:
A 7 year-old using image generation to improvise a game of chess with characters.  
A 6 year-old observing corals in our lagoon and learning about marine biology.  
A 7 year-old doing her math homework on multiplications by the beach.  
A 9 year-old spotted a hidden fossile and started exploring for more.

I'm with two other dads and engineers, our goal is to build a smart interactive learning world designed to spark and nurture kids curiosity. It leverages AI end-to-end: from parent onboarding (we create a dynamic map of the knowledge of the kid that we then adjust after each session to identify the proximal zone of development of the kid) to the game itself where we have real-time NPCs, we're working on an automated pipeline for our 3D assets in-game (we use both Meshy and Unity in the process), and we have much deeper AI features in the making (craft system, world generation...). 

It's still in its super minimal version right now, but if you want to try it with you kids, the beta is available on Testflight [here](https://testflight.apple.com/join/FjgvHC8Q) and you can find more info here: [https://withmarble.com/](https://withmarble.com/)
